audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers had Urgot winning all seven rows, but whys[0] says 'Level 1 is even' and whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say two-item Zac is a wall you cannot kill 1v1. Packet levelChart: Skill, Urgot x5, Zac.
audit.why: Urgot is 54.28% over 643 games and owns the lane proper, but Zac's level-1 blob poke trades evenly and his full-tank scaling takes the late 1v1 back.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side/win[0] to Skill (5/10) and phases[6].side/win[6] to Zac (3/10), with phases[6].why rewritten.

audit.why: Spike placement holds: Urgot from 3-5, at 6 with the execute, and at first item; Zac only at full-tank scaling. The chart now agrees.
audit.corrected: Spike timings unchanged; spikes[0] and spikes[1] text corrected for names and mechanics.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability names were wrong — 'Let's Bounce' (real name Let's Bounce!) and 'Q Stretching Strike' (real name Stretching Strikes) — and three flagged interactions were missing entirely: Cell Division's blob healing and revive, Unstable Matter's percent-max-health damage, and the fact that raw resists are the wrong answer to both.
audit.why: Unstable Matter is a flat 5s cooldown dealing a percentage of maximum health as magic damage, so armour and health stacking mispriced the trade. Cell Division sheds reabsorbable chunks and revives him from bloblets on fatal damage — which is exactly what makes 'flip-execute him cleanly' an overclaim. Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s and Let's Bounce! is 120/105/90s, neither of which appeared as a number anywhere.
audit.corrected: Both names fixed; the revive stated in spikes[1]; percent-health stated in dosFull[2].d; blob healing stated in dontsFull[0].d; the 21s Slingshot window in dontsFull[1].d.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Zac must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: Two items in Zac becomes a full-tank wall — Unstable Matter chews max health every 5s, so cash your lead early and never duel him late.

edits.before: His R Let's Bounce is an engage/escape, not a duel tool — 1v1 it does little. Your R Fear Beyond Death flips and executes him cleanly since he has no dash mid-flip. Punish any time he Q-pulls a minion by W-draining him while his passive is on cooldown.
edits.after: His R Let's Bounce! is an engage tool, not a duel tool — four bounces of knock-up on a 120s cooldown. Your R Fear Beyond Death flips and executes him, but Cell Division revives him from bloblets, so make sure his bloblets die too.

edits.before: Zac's poke comes from Q Stretching Strike and E-blob pickups he can't gather under your pressure. Q Corrosive Charge him, W Purge to remove his passive blobs off the ground before he heals off them, and E Disdain into a trade — he has no burst to answer a Juggernaut. Deny the blobs and he bleeds out.
edits.after: Zac's poke comes from Stretching Strikes and the Cell Division blobs he can't gather under your pressure. Q Corrosive Charge him, W Purge to remove the blobs off the ground before he heals off them, and E Disdain into a trade — he has no burst to answer a Juggernaut. Deny the blobs and he bleeds out.

edits.before: Zac wastes Elastic Slingshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Unstable Matter hits max health every 5s — resists alone won't save you.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Cell Division blobs heal him back — step on them or Purge them off the ground.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — punish him hard in that long window.

edits.before: R flip-execute him — he has no dash mid-suppression
edits.after: R flip-execute him once Elastic Slingshot is spent

notes: I honoured the mirror's warning and did NOT apply the _missing-interactions claim that Elastic Slingshot grounds Urgot's Q — the mirror audit established that the 'grounding' flag in champ-data/_kits/zac.json is a tooltip-parsing artefact of the word 'ground' in Riot's text, and the kit description contains no grounding effect. Nothing I wrote references it. Also removed the unverifiable 'he has no dash mid-suppression' phrasing from wants.you[2] rather than restating it: Urgot's R impale is not described as a suppression in Riot's text, and Zac does have a dash.
